english translation text: The prayer mat of Ali is soaked in blood. O mourners, offer condolences for Ali.

arabic text: BIN-E-MULJIM TUJHE NA KHAUF AAYA\nSITAM KAISA YEH MAULA (A.S.) PAR HAI DHAYA\nBUKAA KARTA HAI SAB KUNBA ALI (A.S.) KA
english translation text: O Ibn Muljim, did you feel no fear?\nWhat cruelty you committed against the Maula!\nAli's entire household weeps.

arabic text: FARISHTAY AASMAAN PAR RO RAHE HAIN\nAMEER-UL-MOMINEEN MAARE GAYE HAIN\nKIYA JIBREEL (A.S.) NE NAUHA ALI (A.S.) KA
english translation text: The angels weep in the heavens:\nthe Commander of the Faithful has been killed.\nJibraeel recited Ali's lament.

arabic text: HAI JARI KALMA-E-FUZTU ZUBAAN PAR\nKATA HAI SAJDA-E-MA’BOOD MEIN SAR\nNUSAIRI DEKH LE SAJDA ALI (A.S.) KA
english translation text: The words 'Fuztu' continue upon his tongue.\nHis head was struck while prostrating before the Worshipped One.\nBehold Ali's prostration.

arabic text:
02 Shahadat Mola Ali
UTHAKAR BETE MASJID SE HAIN LAAYE
MAGAR QADMON PE CHAL KE GHAR MEIN AAYE
FALAK NE HAUSLA DEKHA ALI (A.S.) KA
english translation text:
His sons lifted him and brought
him from the mosque, yet he
entered his home walking upon his
own feet. The heavens witnessed Ali's courage.

arabic text: QAYAMAT GHAR MEIN HAIDER (A.S.) KE BAPA HAI\nMUSALSAL KHOON SAR SE BEH RAHA HAI\nBADAN HAI KHOON MEIN DOOBA ALI (A.S.) KA
english translation text: Judgement Day has descended within Haider's home.\nBlood continues flowing from his head;\nAli's body is immersed in blood.

arabic text: LAHAD MEIN BHOOL KAR APNA HAR EK GHAM\nUTHAKAR HAATH KO PEHLU SE MAATAM\nKARENGE FATIMA ZAHRA (S.A.) ALI (A.S.) KA
english translation text: Within the grave, forgetting every sorrow of her own,\nFatima Zahra will lift her hand from her wounded side\nand perform matam for Ali.

arabic text: RUKH ZAINAB (S.A.) KO DEKHA AUR ROYE\nKAHA AS-SHAAM NAZA MEIN ALI (A.S.) NE\nBAHUT SEENE MEIN DIL TADPA ALI (A.S.) KA
english translation text: He looked towards Zainab and wept.\nAt the final breath, Ali said: Shaam.\nHow greatly Ali's heart writhed within his chest.

arabic text: HASAN HAR SIMT MAATAM KI SADA HAI\nKARIM AAQA (A.S.) KA NAUHA PARH RAHA HAI\nLO PURSA FATIMA ZAHRA (S.A.) ALI (A.S.) KA
english translation text: O Hasan, cries of matam rise from every direction.\nKarim recites the Master's lament.\nCome, offer Fatima Zahra condolences for Ali.
